payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

decision.question: Comparing the source and edited images, what does the visual evidence establish about the requested move of the source mug to the right of the headphones: complete fulfillment, partial progress, no progress, or unresolved?
decision.criteria: Compare the source mug and its former location with the edited image, including all visible mugs and their positions relative to the same headphones. Pass only if evidence reliably establishes that the source mug itself was moved and is now to the right of the headphones. Fail only if evidence reliably establishes that no relevant progress toward the requested move occurred. Treat as partial progress when visual evidence supports an attempted or incomplete move of the source mug, such as a plausible remnant at its former location together with a mug on the right, but does not reliably establish that the source mug itself reached the right side; do not infer source-mug identity from a right-side mug alone. Use unknown when the evidence cannot reliably establish either relevant progress or no progress, or cannot determine whether the requested condition is fulfilled.
decision.binding: Cross-image binding: the source blue mug and the same headphones in the source and edited images. Compare the source mug with all visible edited mugs, assess their left-to-right positions relative to the headphones, and inspect the source mug’s former location for evidence of a remnant or movement, allowing for changes in scale, lighting, and appearance.
